findings.message: Cancellation mishandled. The cancellation token is now passed to `SendPingAsync`, so a cancelled token throws `OperationCanceledException`/`TaskCanceledException`. No catch handles it before the generic `catch (Exception ex)`. On every normal shutdown or stop, each in-flight ping logs a stack trace at Warning level as "Unexpected error pinging". The method also returns `false`, so the caller may mark devices offline or broadcast an offline status during shutdown. Add `catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)` before the generic catch and rethrow, or return without logging.
